subject: A venue, an art room and a pair of glasses walked into the week

hero.statement: Three signals that immersive is scaling this week
hero.sub: A venue outsold every arena, an art room pulled millions, and AR glasses got a price. Three separate moves, one direction.

sections.statement: Sphere outsold every arena on earth
sections.body: Billboard and Pollstar ranked the Las Vegas Sphere the top grossing venue in the world for 2025. The Wizard of Oz at Sphere alone has sold more than 2 million tickets and 260 million dollars since its 2025 debut.
sections.why: When one immersive room outsells arenas, the surface itself becomes the product worth owning a moment inside.

sections.statement: teamLab drew millions to one museum
sections.body: teamLab Borderless, reopened in Tokyo's Azabudai Hills, welcomed about 1.69 million visitors in 2025, and teamLab pulled over 4.2 million across its two Tokyo museums in a year. Footfall most retail anchors would envy.
sections.why: A room people line up to walk inside is a leasing magnet. Immersive is becoming the anchor, not the amenity.

sections.statement: AR glasses got a price and a ship date
sections.body: Snap unveiled its Specs AR glasses at Augmented World Expo: 2,195 dollars, preorders open, shipping this fall. A feature called EyeConnect lets two wearers share the same AR just by making eye contact.
sections.why: Shared AR by eye contact is a group mechanic. That is an activation waiting to happen, not a solo gadget.

invitation.headline: Own a moment inside the room
invitation.body: The surface is the product now. We design wraparound, responsive environments at activation scale, white label, under your name.
